We’re still living with the consequences of that dark day!October 7. The grief didn’t stay behind in Gaza. It followed us. This morning, I lost another one of my cats. She was hit by a car right in front of my home. She’s the eighth out of my nine cats that I’ve lost. Sometimes it feels like life just keeps finding new ways to break what’s left of my heart.. #rip #rest #loss #🐾

Do you hear that? The constant gunfire? The shelling? And they tell the world there is a ceasefire? There is no pause. No reprieve. No safety for Palestinians in Gaza. On October 11, our team visited families whose tents had been burned, leaving them without shelter once again. Even as we filmed, heavy gunfire echoed around us. This is the reality of life in Gaza. Families who have lost everything continue to live under the threat of violence, yet refuse to be driven from their land. This is what steadfastness looks like. Sumud. A determination that is difficult to comprehend unless you understand what it means to face the loss of your homeland. They have burned their shelters, destroyed their neighborhoods, and displaced them again and again. But they have not broken their connection to Palestine. They are not leaving. They are not surrendering their right to exist on their land. Help support them. The Sameer Project is one of the only organizations that delivers aid in these danger zones. American rapper Macklemore opened his ‘Free Palestine’ tour before a sold-out crowd in Dublin after announcing that all tour proceeds would support organisations helping Palestinians.  The three-city tour comes after his exclusion from Ed Sheeran’s concerts following pro-Palestinian remarks.

#Macklemore kicks off his “Free Palestine” tour with a call for unity just over a month after being dropped from #EdSheeran’s tour over his political remarks onstage: “Six weeks ago, it was two words. Two words is all that it took. Two words that are rooted in love and liberation. Not against anybody, not divisive. Not a call for hatred. But a call to recognize our shared humanity. Free Palestine. I said free Palestine! The same thing that I want for all of us, freedom, dignity, the right to exist without fear. Being able to raise our children in the homes that we grew up in, not having to prove our humanity to the rest of the world."
